tools.name: oksign_get_credits
tools.description: The account's remaining credits (quantity), when they expire (validuntil), the plan (subscription), whether it is paid, and storage used (account_size) versus the maximum (max_account_size) in bytes. GET /v1/credits/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_list_users
tools.description: The users of the OKsign account: name, email, mobile, role, status, language and the immutable signerid (use it to tell who signed). GET /v1/users/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_list_email_templates
tools.description: The email templates defined in the account: id, name, subject, HTML body, reminder_days and repeat. GET /v1/email-templates/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_list_contacts
tools.description: The account's contact list: name, email, mobile, actingas (capacity) and group. GET /v1/contacts/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_list_active_documents
tools.description: Documents in the account's Active Documents tab: docid, filename, creator, createdate, signatures required/valid, orgtoken, status (1 active, 10 briefcase, 11 document in a briefcase, 12 reusable, 14 template), viaapi and signed_docid when signed. OKsign allows this call only once every 3 minutes (4

tools.name: oksign_list_signed_documents
tools.description: Documents uploaded through the API that were signed between two moments: signed_docid, source_docid, filename, signerid, signing source, signature counts, completed fields, credits per signer and timestamp. Keep the window short; OKsign allows this call only once every 3 minutes (429 otherwise). GET

tools.name: oksign_list_notification_errors
tools.description: Email and SMS delivery problems (hard_bounce, soft_bounce, blocked, spam, invalid_email, deferred) for signing invitations sent between two moments: recipient, source_docid, reason, orgtoken and timestamp. Only error events are reported. OKsign allows this call only once every 3 minutes (429 otherwi

tools.name: oksign_document_exists
tools.description: Whether a (signed) document still exists on the platform; returns its filename and whether it is a template. GET /v1/document/exists.

tools.name: oksign_get_document_metadata
tools.description: Metadata of a signed document (pass the signed_docid): filename, size, signatures required/valid, who signed, and the values of all completed fields (can contain personal data). Metadata v2. GET /v2/metadata/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_get_form_descriptor
tools.description: The form descriptor of an uploaded document: its signature and form fields (type, page, position, signer, required, signing options) and the signing URL of each signer. The URLs let their holders sign, so share them only with the signer. GET /v1/formdesc/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_get_linked_document
tools.description: Given a source_docid, the signed_docid of its signed copy (absent if not signed yet) and the timestamp; given a signed_docid, the source_docid. An empty result means the document never existed here or was removed. GET /v1/linkedlist/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_upsert_contacts
tools.description: WRITE: add contacts to the account's contact list, or update them when a contact with the same email AND name exists (its other fields are replaced). Existing contacts are never cleared. Contacts OKsign rejects are skipped and reported. POST /v1/contacts/upload.

tools.name: oksign_remove_contacts
tools.description: WRITE: permanently remove contacts from the account's contact list. A contact is identified by its email AND name. Cannot be undone (re-add with oksign_upsert_contacts). POST /v1/contacts/remove.

tools.name: oksign_remove_document
tools.description: WRITE: permanently remove a (signed) document from the OKsign platform. This deletes the file and its pending webhook events and cannot be undone. A signed document removed right after its callback may answer 'Too soon': retry later. DELETE /v1/document/remove.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: oksign_list_users, oksign_list_email_templates, oksign_list_contacts, oksign_list_notification_errors, oksign_get_form_descriptor, oksign_upsert_contacts, oksign_remove_contacts · Private data: oksign_list_contacts, oksign_list_active_documents, oksign_list_signed_documents, oksign_document_exists, oksign_get_document_metadata, oksign_get_form_descriptor, oksign_get_linked_document, oksign_upsert_contacts, oksign_remove_contacts, oksign_remove_document · Public sink: oksign_list_users, oksign_list_email_templates, oksign_list_contacts, oksign_list_notification_errors, oksign_get_form_descriptor, oksign_upsert_contacts, oksign_remove_contacts, oksign_remove_document · Destructive: oksign_remove_contacts, oksign_remove_document.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
